final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters (NFD) and drops the combining marks before calling `slugify`. I did not touch `vendor/slugify`, because the vendor README says never to edit those files by hand.

The same vendored `slugify` drops accents in `src/shop/product-url.js`, so product URLs have the same bug. I left that alone because it's outside this task. The fix would be the same two-line change there if you want it.

I didn't commit anything.
